suggested_solution: Update BIOS to the latest version (510) and ensure all drivers are up-to-date.
Adjust Thermal Settings: Fan Curve = Low/Medium, Thermal Thresholds = 80°C for CPU, 85°C for GPU.
Optimize Performance Settings: Power Mode = Performance/Standard, Graphics Settings = balanced performance and temperature.
Resource Management: CPU Governor = Performance/Highest Performance, GPU Governor = Performance/Highest Performance.
